title: Inclusion proof
description: The path proving one entry is in the tree, as inclusionProof() in src/domain/merkle.ts returns it. A root says a set was committed to; this says a particular entry was in that set. A reader recomputes the root from the entry they hold, the path and the root they fetched elsewhere, which verifyInclusion() does. A promoted odd node has no sibling and contributes no step, so the path is shorter than the tree is tall for some entries and empty for a one-entry tree. Every digest is lower-case hex with a 0x prefix. Unknown keys are refused unless prefixed `x-`.

entryId.description: The id of the entry the proof is for.

leaf.description: The leaf hash of that entry: SHA256(0x00 || canonical).

path.description: Bottom to top, one step per level at which the entry's node had a sibling.

root.description: The root the path leads to.

hex.description: A sha256 digest: 0x, then 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

step.description: One level of the path: the sibling to combine with, and which side it sits on.

side.description: Which side the sibling sits on when recomputing the parent. Mirrors `ProofStep` in src/domain/merkle.ts; tests/schema.test.mjs fails if the two drift.
